Name: Erossavia's SlimeHutch Armory
Author: Erossavia
Description:
Just a SlimeHutch map remodel. Can be used as a SlimeHutch (water troughs are still there and usable) or as a Forge/Armory with a direct link to the Blacksmith shop (click the anvil).

Simple .XNB file replacement mod. Simply download, extract and place the SlimeHutch.xnb file contained within into your Stardew Valley/Content/Maps folder, hit yes to replace it and you're done. No other downloads or mods necessary.
